messages:
andrea: Quick sync — planning a small change to session-store rolling update to stop 1-2s connection drops during deploys. Thinking: set strategy.type: RollingUpdate with maxUnavailable: 0, maxSurge: 1 (absolute) and add a preStop sleep to drain conns. Also want to wire Terraform var session_store_replicas so we can bump during canaries. Thoughts?

ben: Prefer percentage for surge, e.g., maxSurge: "25%". Absolute 1 might be too small for larger clusters. Also watch PDB — if PDB.minAvailable=1 and replicas=1 surge=1 still ok but if replicas small, maxUnavailable:0 + tiny surge -> no progress. What are current replica counts?

andrea: Currently replicas = 2 in k8s manifest. PDB.minAvailable = 1. We run in Dedicated; can't afford double replicas for long. Here's the deploy snippet I'm proposing:

```yaml
strategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    maxUnavailable: 0
    maxSurge: 1
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: session-store
        lifecycle:
          preStop:
            exec:
              command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "sleep 10"]
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
```

ben: preStop sleep 10 should help, but consider graceful shutdown hooks in app. Also adjust readiness to fail faster on shutdown to let kube drain. And update HPA.minReplicas if HPA present.

maria: For terraform side, add variable in modules/apps/session-store/variables.tf:

```hcl
variable "replicas" {
  type = number
  default = 2
}
```

and reference it in the k8s template (helm/templating):

```hcl
replicas = var.replicas
```

Then we'll expose an input in env-specific tfvars for canary.

sam: I'll open a PR with these changes + a tiny test job. Ping me on the review: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/compare/... @ben @maria

deploy-bot: k8s-deploy session-store staging started by sam — build 1045 — status: queued

ben: one more thing — if we switch to maxUnavailable:0 + maxSurge:1 and replicas=2, worst-case nodes may schedule extra pod causing memory pressure. Add resource requests/limits to manifest:

```yaml
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: "200m"
    memory: "512Mi"
  limits:
    cpu: "500m"
    memory: "1Gi"
```

andrea: Agreed. Sam — can you include resource changes and a note in PR description about PDB interactions? I'll run a canary tomorrow (0900 PT). :thumbsup: 

sam: will do. PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/789 — added changelog, tf var, manifest, resources, preStop. Requesting review.

maria: If canary looks good, I'll bump canary replicas in tfvars to 3 for 30m then revert. Remind me to run smoke tests for session affinity.

andrea: Thanks all. I'll document in infra-runbook under session-store rollout checklist.
